pages.title: Convergence Engine
pages.text: Does in a box what the Convergence Altar does with pedestals and patience: every convergence ritual, fed by pipes like any machine.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 6$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.
Runs every $(item)Convergence Altar$() recipe: the core and every pedestal item go into its input slots together, at four times the energy.

$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (13 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Chronoplastic Gasket, Coherent Wiring Harness, Cosmic Flux Coupler, Entangled Bus Bar, Omnilex Seal, Ontological Junction, Spacetime Bearing, Transfinite Lattice Bolt.
